How this plan works (30-second manual)

  • Weekdays (Mon–Fri): every day shows the chapter name to revise (only the name — you decide how deep). 12th chapters only, synced to what your tuition has covered.
  • Weekends (Sat–Sun): Class 11th syllabus — the 20% of MHT-CET everyone skips. Fixed topics, full rotation, finished by Dec 13.
  • Boards: prep phase Jan 4 → Feb 10 (PCM + English + Fine Arts + Typography), then flexible exam weeks from ~Feb 15.
  • JEE: appearing "just for the experience" — no prep, no guilt, doesn't touch this plan.
  • MCQs + Notes tab: 36 practice MCQs with instant answers + editable short-notes pads for every subject. One place, everything.
  • Tick tasks → progress updates everywhere. Task Board → drag weeks to Deferred if you fall behind. All saved in your browser.

Weekdays — 12th revision + chapter targets Mon–Fri · 17 Aug → 11 Dec 2026

How it works: each day shows the chapter to revise (name only — you do the depth). Chapters follow your tuition's pace: Aug: EMI → AC Circuits · Sep: Optics · Oct: Modern Physics · Nov: Semiconductors (tuition ends ~Nov 25). Morning = deep work on that chapter, evening = MCQs on it. Later weeks flip to mock mode as Attempt 1 nears.

Weekends — Class 11th syllabus Sat–Sun · 22 Aug → 13 Dec 2026

Why 11th on weekends: MHT-CET = 80% Class 12 + 20% Class 11 (~30 questions ≈ 60 marks that CBSE kids skip). Full 11th PCM rotation, finished by December. Bonus: most "extra" MH-board XII chapters (Thermodynamics, Oscillations, Fluids, KTG…) are secretly CBSE-XI chapters — covered here for free. See Guide → MH map.
DAY 0 — Sun 16 Aug: setup day. 2 notebooks (formula book + error log), bookmark cetcell.mahacet.org / ebalbharati.in / ncert.nic.in, sleep early. Launch: Mon 17 Aug 🔋

CBSE Boards prep Jan 4 → Feb 10 · exams from ~Feb 15 · boards = free MHT revision

Your board subjects: Physics · Chemistry · Maths · English + Fine Arts & Typography (additional). Prep ends Feb 10; exam weeks (from ~Feb 15) are execution mode — flexible, because the CBSE date sheet (usually out in Dec) decides the order. JEE Main Session 1 (expected ~late Jan): you're giving it as a free dry run — no prep, just experience. Zero impact on this plan. During exams, one MHT-CET section mock per day keeps Attempt 2 warm.

Attempt 2 campaign Dec 2026 → May/Jun 2027 · where 140/200 becomes real

Real talk: Attempt 1 (mid-Dec) is your live-fire dry run. Attempt 2 (expected Apr 2027) is the championship campaign, and best of two counts. Strategy for 140+: Maths carries 100 marks — make it your fortress (target ≥65), split the rest between Physics (≥38) and Chemistry (≥37). Attempt everything — no negative marking. Tick items as you finish them.
Dates to verify: Attempt 2 expected Apr 2027 (some sources: May–Jun). JEE Main Session 2 (~Apr) — optional second dry run, only if it doesn't clash with MHT prep. MIT-WPU: MHT-CET score + SOP (500 words). Backup lanes: JEE score, MIT-WPU CET, direct merit.

  • No negative marking → never leave a blank.
  • 80% Class 12 · 20% Class 11 (MH board syllabus).
  • Difficulty: board ↔ JEE-Main. Speed + accuracy wins.

Golden rules

  • Error log: every wrong MCQ → notebook with the concept. Review Sundays. Worth 10 percentile points.
  • Formula book: use the 📝 Notes tab here — all formulas chapter-wise, one place.
  • Mock discipline: from Week 12, mocks are exam-sim: timed, no phone, no pause.
  • Phone: another room during deep blocks. 90 focused minutes > 4 distracted hours.
  • Sleep 7h+: your brain files what you studied while you sleep.
  • Valo + GF time = protected. Scheduled, guilt-free. Happy brain studies better.
  • Boards = MHT revision. One effort, two exams. Never study them as separate worlds.
  • JEE is a free try. No prep, no stress — walk in, attempt, learn how exam pressure feels.

Resources

  • MHT-CET official: cetcell.mahacet.org — registration (expected Sep–Oct 2026), dates, syllabus PDF, sample papers.
  • MH textbooks (free): ebalbharati.in — extra chapters + question style.
  • NCERT + Exemplar: ncert.nic.in — theory bible for boards.
  • CBSE: cbse.gov.in — date sheet (Dec), sample papers, practical guidelines.
  • JEE Main: jeemain.nta.nic.in — register for the free try (Session 1 expected ~Jan 2027).
  • MIT-WPU: mitwpu.edu.in — SOP format, MET backup.

Exam-day checklist print this mentally

  • Admit card (2 printouts) + ID + passport photo.
  • Formula one-pager for the morning — no new cramming.
  • Reach the centre 60–90 min early.
  • MHT: Section 1 (P+C) then Section 2 (Maths). Attempt everything.
  • Sleep ≥ 8h the night before. No new topics after 6 pm prior day.
  • Water + light meal before. You're not hungry, you're just nervous — hydrate anyway.
